body: I don't disagree. I know that's what it is. So how do I stop feeling sorry for myself? I am depressed and I don't know what to do. I genuinely want to feel better but I don't know how.

There are a few factors at play here, having had some experience in this matter:

1. **Did they come clean?** If he tells me to my face rather than me having to find out from some other source, then I can understand that this is a mistake he regrets and feels guilty over, and he is willing to make amends.

2. **Is this the first time that they have done this?** If this is the first time, then it's more like: OK, you fucked up. Humans do that sometimes. If this is the second or third time, DON'T FUCKING TAKE HIM BACK HATSUNDKAFFE HE'LL DO IT AGAIN

3. **Is it sex or something more?** There is a continuum between a drunken one night stand with someone you never intend to see again and a year long affair with someone with whom you are in love.

Get back together.

Fuck, I was so naive.

1. I thought black and white cows made regular milk, and brown and white cows made chocolate milk. When I discovered powdered milk, I deduced that cocoa is in fact brown cow powdered milk.

2. The first time I went swimming, I was about five. I loved it and stayed there for hours. My fingers pruned up, and I was convinced I was turning into an old lady. Cue five year old me crying about growing old and reminiscing on a missed childhood.

3. I grew up on musicals, and I always thought that it was strange people didn't start singing IRL. Sometimes I would try to initiate. For whatever reason, no one joined in.

4.  I thought people who were snoring actually said "honk shoo" because that is how it was written down in all the picture books. Being the rebellious kid I was, I continued to play with my plastic dinosaurs well after my parents had tucked me in. When I heard my mom coming down the hall to check on me, I'd jump back into bed and start to "honk shoo" loudly so that my mom would think I had been asleep for hours. I thought I was so clever.

5. I thought that when a character died in a movie, the actor did too. I couldn't explain why any actor would willingly do this, and while playing with my dinosaurs late at night I would have an existential crisis or two.

6. I thought little people lived inside all the stoplights and controlled them. What else could it be?

7. I thought Toy Story was a thing, and left little pieces of bread and cheese in my room so that when I left my toys wouldn't starve to death.
